learnings: Fixtures build what a test needs and clean up after `yield`; factory fixtures keep tests short and explicit.
Stacked `parametrize` decorators multiply cases; `ids` and `pytest.param` make failures readable.
`Mock(spec=...)` fails on methods the real class doesn't have, and call assertions verify interactions.
pitfalls: `assert a == b if cond else c` parses as `assert (a == b) if cond else c` – one branch silently asserted nothing until rewritten.
